placement_conflict.why: The 77 ft 10 in dimension starts at the outer south wall of the smoking/baggage-room row. The 262 ft dimension starts at the wing front, not the projecting hall front. Printed chains and raster ratios disagree.
placement_conflict.global_z: Unknown. No hall-floor-to-cargo-floor/deck relationship has been recovered. MDOT 12–14 ft is clear height, not deck elevation.

interfaces.ramp: The current Y87.8 end is unverified. The historical down-ramp led to a subway and stairs up, not to the deck surface. A 2024 report states that the old platform tunnels are sealed.
interfaces.cuts_required_now: None. No further cut is justified until position, elevation and the sealed interface are controlled.
